name: Tooltip
summary: A short, high-contrast label for a control, shown on hover and focus or opened as a hint popover.
description:
Use a tooltip to name an icon-only control or add a few words of help. Never put the only copy of important information, or anything interactive, in a tooltip.

There are two forms: wrap the trigger and tooltip in .v-tooltip-wrap for a pure CSS tooltip on hover and focus, or use popover="hint" opened by its trigger.

classes.name: v-tooltip
classes.description: The label, with role="tooltip". Above its trigger by default.

classes.name: v-tooltip-bottom
classes.description: Popover form: places it below the trigger.

classes.name: v-tooltip-wrap
classes.description: No-popover form: wraps the trigger and the tooltip, which shows on hover and keyboard focus.

states.description: Popover form: shown in the top layer without closing other popovers. Browsers without hint treat it as a manual popover.
On the trigger: the tooltip id, so the text is read as the control's description.

keyboard.action: Focuses the trigger. In the wrap form the tooltip shows while the trigger has focus.
Popover form: the trigger opens or closes the tooltip.

a11y: Point the trigger's aria-describedby at the tooltip; for an icon-only button the name still goes in aria-label.
The wrap form shows on keyboard focus as well as hover. Escape to dismiss it comes with the JS modules.
The text uses the page text colour on the page background, reversed, so it keeps strong contrast in both themes.

examples.title: On hover and focus
examples.description: No popover and no script: hover the button or Tab to it.
examples.html: No popover needed

examples.title: Hint popover
examples.description: Opened by its trigger with popovertarget and placed above it where anchor positioning exists.
examples.html: Placed above its trigger
